detail.errorMessage: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/developer is not authorized to perform: s3:PutBucketAcl on resource: "arn:aws:s3:::my-sensitive-data-bucket" because public ACLs are prevented by the BlockPublicAcls setting in S3 Block Public Access.
detail._comment: Captured from a live account on 2026-09-19. A real PutBucketAcl that AWS REJECTED: Block Public Access refused the public-read ACL, so the bucket was never public. CloudTrail logs failed calls and EventBridge delivers them, so the engine receives this exactly like a successful one. Account id, bucket name, principal id and user name are sanitised; errorCode, errorMessage and requestParameters are verbatim.
